lines.text: NVIDIA board met overnight on CEO Jensen Huang's future; no outcome yet, shares down about 5% premarket
Nebius Q3 revenue is $980.8M; company points to the low end of its $3.0 to $3.4B 2026 guide
DeepMind releases AlphaGenome 2, trained on more than 100 million cell profiles across 68 tissues

feed.headline: NVIDIA board met overnight on CEO Jensen Huang's future; no outcome announced yet
feed.why: CNBC, at 6:06 AM ET, said shares were down about 5% premarket. WSJ reported the board was preparing to remove him. NVIDIA has not confirmed a change.

feed.headline: Nebius Q3 revenue is $980.8M; 2026 guide moves to the low end of $3.0-$3.4B
feed.why: Official print: $980.8M vs $146.1M a year earlier, $37.5M net loss, adjusted EBITDA $465.8M. 2026 capex rises to about $27B; 2027 revenue is $12-$13B.

feed.headline: DeepMind releases AlphaGenome 2, trained on more than 100 million cell profiles
feed.why: DeepMind says it found nearly twice as many expression-changing variants as the prior model on TenK10K (30% vs 16%). Free for non-commercial research.

feed.headline: Google launches the Gemini Decisions API, powered by Gemini Decision 1
feed.why: Scores up to 1,000 yes/no, choice, or rubric questions on one shared multimodal input. $0.10 per 1M input tokens, with no output-token charge, per Google.

feed.headline: Runway releases Praxis-1 open weights under Apache 2.0, including commercial use
feed.why: A 27B-parameter world-action model for robots, with weights and code on Hugging Face and GitHub. Runway's RoboLab-120 comparison is a lab claim.

feed.headline: Anthropic finds group results worsen when each user has their own agent
feed.why: In four simulated shared-resource settings, one agent serving everyone beat a team of per-user agents. Three environments are released as MAMUBench.
